# Telegram Media Downloader

> Self-hosted Telegram media downloader with a web dashboard. It downloads and backs up photos, videos, documents, voice messages, GIFs, stickers and Stories from Telegram channels, groups and DMs (including private ones you belong to) using your own account over MTProto. Runs in Docker or on Node.js; MIT licensed.

The app is Node.js (Express, SQLite, gramJS) plus tgdl-core, a required Go binary that does hashing, integrity checks, folder walks, face clustering and serves every media byte as the front server on PORT. Optional sidecars, each runnable locally or on another machine: faces-service (Python, face clustering), nsfw-service (Python, NSFW review), seekbar-service (Go, video hover previews).
